title: claim_work answer
description: The memory tool claim_work's answer (migration 081): a work item claimed by this session, or its claim renewed. claim names the claim with its id, which only its holder keeps: claim_work with it renews the claim, update_work with it moves the item's state while it holds, release_work with it ends it; renewed says this call renewed one. A claim holds for 2 hours from when it was made or last renewed. An item in backlog or ready moves to active: changed is ["work_state"], the state before is kept as a version and history records it (work_changed); otherwise changed is empty, and the claim moves no revision either way. Refused: claimed (a live claim of another session holds it: the error names its label and when it ends), invalid (a finished item, a memory that is no work item, a claim id that names no live claim, or a label that reads like instructions), held, retracted and conflict. Listed and answered only with memory.tools and memory.work on, and refused (off) with the second off (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body.
